title: Pocketwire Business Profile Shortfall Reserve on Personal Balance Transfers
content:
When a customer's Pocketwire Business Profile is in deficit, part of their Pocketwire Personal Account balance is kept back from a transfer of the whole available balance.

> The business shortfall reserve on the available transfer amount reads the customer's Pocketwire Business Profile: when its business balance is below zero and no business sale was booked on it in the last month, 100 percent of the shortfall is kept back; when its balance is below zero and at least one sale was booked in the last month, 50 percent of the shortfall is kept back; otherwise nothing is kept back; the reserve is rounded to the cent (half up).

The shortfall is the amount by which the business balance is below zero. A sale counts in the last month when it is dated later than the same calendar day one month before the handling date.

**Input — judgement — output**

- *Input:* the business balance of the Pocketwire Business Profile, and the business sales booked on it in the last month.
- *Judgement:* is the balance below zero? If so, was any business sale booked in the last month?
- *Output:* balance below zero and no sale: 100 percent of the shortfall; balance below zero and at least one sale: 50 percent of the shortfall; balance at zero or above, or no Pocketwire Business Profile: nothing.

**Illustrations (hypothetical figures)**

| Business balance | Sales in the last month | Kept back |
|---|---|---|
| Minus 180.00 | None | 180.00 |
| Minus 180.00 | Two | 90.00 |
| Minus 75.25 | One | 37.625, rounded half up to 37.63 |
| 40.00 | None | Nothing |
